findings.title: Pulse approval admits duplicate remote jobs under concurrency or post-RPC persistence failure
findings.proposal_delta: Prioritize durable admission and effect receipts on existing Pulse approval; digest/fyi is read-only and unaffected by remote-job duplication.
findings.proof: pulse-admission-probe.test.ts: two adversarial tests pass by observing two cron.add calls. Database and gateway mocked; no external effects.

findings.title: Hub already contains generation-fenced background runtime and provider-effect protocol
findings.proposal_delta: Reuse bg-runtime; adapt its existing receipt protocol for a narrow LLM classifier/research step rather than add Pi Durable. Existing embedding helper is not a generic LLM helper.

findings.title: Default scheduled tick intentionally skips the job queue
findings.proposal_delta: Qualify an explicitly targeted worker/handler and scheduler ownership; do not blindly enable global ?jobs=1 because it revives unrelated dormant jobs.

findings.title: Gateway cron persistence does not resume interrupted workflow steps
findings.proposal_delta: Use cron as wakeup only for authoritative durable jobs. Treat timeout as uncertain, not cancellation; keep workflow completion separate from scheduled fire success.

findings.title: Existing Pulse is the near-loop card/decision substrate; feedback adaptation remains absent from inspected path
findings.proposal_delta: Extend Pulse decisions with reason and source/policy revision; preference feedback does not imply automatic weight-learning. Start informational dependency-impact cards.

findings.title: Personal assistant jobs and pipeline workflow executor are not integrated on inspected branch tips
findings.proposal_delta: Do not count prior assistant-jobs proposal code or uncalled workflow functions as shipped infrastructure; choose the active Hub bg-runtime and existing gateway RPC boundary.
